stack: vite + react 19 + tailwind v4 + arc components (CSS modules), reskinned from outside by src/index.css

font.code: Chakra Petch 500/600/700 (controls and chrome); M PLUS Rounded 1c only inside the stage canvas

tokenNotes: index.css :root retunes Arc's semantic tokens for the console skin; write colour edits there. Figma colours are sRGB conversions of the oklch values; convert back to oklch when writing. Translucent tokens (surface, surface-muted, surface-raised, neon-dim, border-subtle) carry their alpha in the variable.

tokens.size/cut: --cut (index.css: 9px notch); geometry of util/notch, not bound
tokens.text-sm/medium: text style: Chakra Petch 500 (buttons, fields, labels)
tokens.text-sm/bold: text style: Chakra Petch 700 (.panel h2, tempo readout)
tokens.shadow/raised: --shadow-raised = --glow (hidden by the notch clip in code too)
tokens.edge/secondary: .booth secondary buttons and triggers: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(0.95 0.05 350 / 0.12)

plateNotes: Notched plates = [Notch (clip-path) instance of util/notch, used as mask] + [Plate rectangle with fill/stroke/effect] + content. Edit the Plate for colour, stroke or radius changes; never edit the notch.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Variant=primary|secondary|ghost x Size=md|lg. Show orb = the .orb span App.tsx renders in pedal and sound buttons.

components.name: Orb
components.notes: On=false: idle pedal. On=true: sounding pedal (--neon) or a lead's ink (LEAD_INK). Swapping On in an instance shows up in the diff as `swaps`.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Label hidden in the bars (.bar label); inside panels it reads --text-secondary (.panel label).

components.name: Slider
components.notes: Thumb position is illustrative; value lives in state.

components.name: Pill
components.notes: CSS class, not a React component.

components.name: util/notch
components.notes: Figma-only helper that reproduces the clip-path. Not a code component.

regions.13:260: Frame web: the .booth CSS background (radial glow + line web) rendered as an image; NOT editable source
regions.5:3: Left aside: pedalPanel('left') in App.tsx (effectsHand = left), incl. Pedal hands SegmentedControl
regions.5:38: Top bar (.bar): Play, Tempo, Key, Scale, Camera, How to play (face HUD only appears with camera on, not drawn)
regions.5:70: Stage (.stage): canvas drawn by src/stage/draw.ts; overlay children are App.tsx JSX passed into <Stage>
regions.5:71: Canvas render image: NOT editable source; ignore its diffs except deletion
regions.5:72: Start overlay (!started): pill + Start with camera / Start with mouse
regions.5:84: Bottom bar (.bar): What the mouse does, Undo, Clear
regions.5:109: Right aside: soundPanel('right') in App.tsx, incl. Mouth drops select

serializeRunsNote: Run serialize.js once per entry (WITH_VARIABLES only on the last run), save each returned object to .uidraw/parts/<n>.json, then node .uidraw/merge.mjs .uidraw/current.json .uidraw/parts/*.json. Add any new top-level frame on the Screens page as its own run.
